Practical Legal Drafting | Legal Notice under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881

As part of my ongoing journey in the field of law, I have drafted a legal notice under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881, concerning the dishonour of a cheque.

This drafting exercise provided me with practical exposure to the legal requirements, structure, and essential elements involved in preparing a cheque dishonour notice.

I believe that legal learning goes beyond textbooks. Understanding how legal provisions are applied in practice is an essential step towards becoming a competent legal professional.

Sharing this work as a part of my learning journey. I welcome constructive feedback and suggestions from legal professionals, advocates, and fellow law students.
